{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Confirm QA orders are still present (but we will not remove them for this question)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")

# Count completed orders (status == 'completed')
completed_orders = df[df['status'] == 'completed']
completed_count = len(completed_orders)

print(f"Number of completed orders: {completed_count}")

# Output the final answer
completed_count"}
